description: Synthetic sesslint.repair.fingerprint parity (module __all__, compute_plan_fingerprint, canonical_json_bytes re-exports).
known_parity_gaps: canonical_json_bytes / plan inputs: JSON Number NaN and Infinity (Python float); Rust float codec rejects them — parity not required here.
canonical_json_bytes: Unicode string containing a lone surrogate (U+D800); Rust Value string is valid Unicode — parity not required here.
canonical_json_bytes: integers outside i64; Rust Value uses i64 — parity not required here.
compute_plan_fingerprint: non-mapping plan. Python may raise TypeError from Mapping; Rust returns codec CanonicalError — if exception text differs from codec error, parity on message is not required.
